name: full-connect-key-site
description: Ferramentas de desenvolvimento e testes do site Full Connect Key (PHP + MySQL). Não é necessário na hospedagem.

scripts.serve:test: FCK_LOGIN_LIMIT=1000 FCK_DB_NAME=fck_site_test FCK_URL=http://localhost:8081 FCK_UPLOADS=uploads-test php -S 127.0.0.1:8081 -t . scripts/router.php
scripts.lint:php: find app scripts index.php tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l | grep -v 'No syntax errors' || true
scripts.check: npm run check:colors && npm run check:strings && npm run test:unit
